initial.cause: The driver compared combined stdout/stderr to the exact version string. The successful first Bazel download emitted a 103-byte informational download line before the 12-byte version line; combined 115-byte equality rejected.
initial.erratum: Initial static review did not detect cold-download informational output on stderr. This was an evidence-parser failure before any lock command, not a Bazel lock or source failure.

revision2.change: Only the Bazel version preflight separates stdout and stderr; strict stdout version equality, original exit/30-second probe budget and 1200-second lock budget are unchanged. Both streams are retained and hashed.

scope: This is only exact-source module-lock freshness. It does not compile project-native code, execute tests or establish Windows security, provider, retention benefit or complete hosted-CI status.
original_warnings: Direct module version and known crate annotation warnings are preserved in the 3211-byte command log. No warning policy or Bazel flags were relaxed.
